TASK: Classify every root-level Markdown file in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite as preserve, relocate to docs/reference, or delete as obsolete, based on actual current repository use.
DELIVERABLE: An evidence-backed table with each root Markdown path, purpose, references/usages, and recommended disposition. Include a concise root-only-README cleanup plan.

VERIFY: Run find for root Markdown and targeted reference searches; cite paths and exact factual evidence for every retained document.
STOP WHEN: Every root Markdown file is classified with a concrete, evidence-backed disposition.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Audit /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/README.md for accuracy, clarity, public branding, and runnable command correctness.
DELIVERABLE: Return a concise evidence-backed contract for a README rewrite: exact product claims justified by manifests/config, exact verified setup/development/build commands, exact canonical clone URL and Pages URL, current GitHub homepage value, and commands to remove if not reliably runnable. Include direct file paths.
SCOPE: Read-only access to README.md, package.json, ui/package.json, site/package.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, site/astro.config.mjs, git remote, and GitHub metadata. Do not edit, move, commit, or push files.
VERIFY: Run `git remote get-url origin`, `gh api repos/Indosaram/ferryx --jq .homepage`, and read every named manifest before reporting. Clearly mark unknowns.
STOP WHEN: The report has all listed fields and is grounded in commands/files you actually inspected.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Repair Ferryx root documentation in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite so the root contains only README.md and README is an accurate, polished project entry point.
DELIVERABLE: Rewrite README.md from verified facts; retain only exact repository clone URL https://github.com/Indosaram/ferryx.git, live Pages URL https://indosaram.github.io/ferryx/, verified installation/development/site commands, concise architecture and contribution guidance. Move current non-README root Markdown references to docs/reference/ if they are current; delete obsolete/superseded root Markdown reports. Return changed paths and validation output.
SCOPE: You may write README.md, move or delete root-level *.md other than README.md, and create docs/reference directories/files only when relocating genuinely current references. Do not alter application source, package manifests, or workflow files. Public wording must use Ferryx only.
VERIFY: First record root Markdown inventory and the pre-edit GitHub homepage API value as RED evidence. Then require final root inventory to be exactly ./README.md, verify README contains canonical URL with a Node extractor, run git diff --check, and execute only safe non-interactive README commands that exist in manifests. Do not commit.
STOP WHEN: Root has only README.md, README is accurate and concise, and all named local checks pass.
